_doc: Figures the server builds for the geometry corpus (app/tests/behavior/geometry_figures_corpus.json), each from a saved figure read. test_server_figures_fixture.py rebuilds every one from its reading (UPDATE_SERVER_FIGURES=1 rewrites them); the phone lays each out and holds every label clear of every stroke and other label (geometryFigureLabels.test.ts).
